name: Beijing E-Hualu Information Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Beijing E-Hualu Information Technology Co., Ltd., a Chinese enterprise, specializes in delivering intelligent traffic management solutions. The company offers a comprehensive range of public infrastructure services, including electronic vehicle registration and identification systems, resilient dual-network and dual-platform solutions, and internet-based urban traffic management. Its portfolio also extends to operation and maintenance management, Internet of Vehicles (IoV) technologies, sophisticated big data application systems, and advanced traffic signal control, catering to governments, businesses, and citizens across various regions. Additionally, E-Hualu provides public security solutions for critical areas like urban rail transit, airports, smart urban parking, public transportation, and traffic monitoring and evaluation. The firm has also developed a health management service platform that supports health and community services through efficient data acquisition, analysis, and operational processes. Established in 2001, its headquarters are situated in Beijing, China.
